title: Email Finder
description: Find a likely work email for each person from their name and company domain. Each guess is checked with a real mailbox probe that never sends mail.

people.title: People
people.description: People to find emails for. Each row needs a first name, last name, and company domain. The sample uses the reserved .invalid domain so a default run finishes without contacting a real mail server.

firstName.title: First name
firstName.description: Given name used to build email guesses.

lastName.title: Last name
lastName.description: Family name used to build email guesses.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Company website, such as stripe.com. https:// and www are ignored.

smtpTimeoutMs.title: SMTP timeout
smtpTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for each SMTP connection, in milliseconds.

maxConcurrentPerDomain.title: Max checks per mail domain
maxConcurrentPerDomain.description: How many mailbox checks may run at the same time against one mail domain. Other domains still run in parallel. The maximum is 3.

smtpProxyUrl.title: SMTP proxy URL
smtpProxyUrl.description: Optional HTTP proxy that allows CONNECT to port 25 (for example http://user:pass@relay.example:8080). Required for mailbox checks on Apify — the platform blocks outbound port 25, and Apify residential proxy cannot tunnel SMTP either. Leave empty for local runs that can dial port 25 directly.
